title: New Zelda and GTA represent a games industry that no longer exists

claims.claim: Grand Theft Auto VI ve The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time yeniden yapımı Kasım ayında piyasaya çıkacak.

evidence.quote: The two biggest games of the year launch in November, offering some reprieve from a terrible year.
The two biggest games of 2026 are set to launch just a few weeks apart in November.
The company’s tentpole release for the holidays, and its next major exclusive for the Switch 2, is a lavish remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

claims.claim: GTA V, 2013 yılında piyasaya sürülmesinden bu yana 230 milyon kopya sattı.

evidence.quote: Its predecessor, GTA V, has sold a staggering 230 million copies since it launched in 2013, and was re-released across three generations of consoles.
Its predecessor, GTA V, has sold a staggering 230 million copies since it launched in 2013

claims.claim: Circana'nın tahminine göre ABD'deki oyuncuların yüzde 29'u Grand Theft Auto VI satın almayı planlıyor.

evidence.quote: Analyst firm Circana estimates that 29 percent of gamers in the US intend to buy the game, with demand so large it could boost flagging console sales.
Analyst firm Circana estimates that 29 percent of gamers in the US intend to buy the game

claims.claim: Canlı aksiyon Zelda filmi 2027 yılında vizyona girecek.
Fortnite geliştiricisi Epic, canlı servis oyunları alanındaki düşüş nedeniyle 1.000'den fazla iş çıkardı.

evidence.quote: Fortnite developer Epic cut more than 1,000 jobs due to a sharp downturn in the live-service games space

claims.claim: EA, BioWare stüdyosunu kapattı ve yeni Mass Effect oyununu iptal etti.

evidence.quote: Just last week, EA shut down beloved studio BioWare and canceled the next Mass Effect game

claims.claim: Sony stüdyosu Sucker Punch, Ghost of Yōtei'nin başarısına rağmen personel azalttı.

evidence.quote: this week Sony studio Sucker Punch cut staff despite the success of last year’s Ghost of Yōtei.
and this week Sony studio Sucker Punch cut staff despite the success of last year’s Ghost of Yōtei.

claims.claim: GTA V, ABD'de üst üste 13 yıl boyunca en çok satan ilk 20 oyun arasında yer aldı.

evidence.quote: GTA V was so massive for so long — Circana says it was among the top 20 best-selling games in the US for 13 straight years
